messages.content: You are a concise technical assistant.
Low-Rank Adaptation freezes the base model and trains small rank-r matrices inserted into the attention/MLP projections. Adapters are 10-500MB instead of 14GB+ for a 7B merged model.
You are a concise technical assistant.
4-bit NF4 cuts base model memory 4x vs fp16. A 7B model fits on 8GB of VRAM, and training a LoRA on top is dominated by the adapter gradients, not the frozen base.
You are a concise technical assistant.
When should I NOT use LoRA?

Full fine-tuning wins when you need to change the base model's world knowledge or tokenizer, or when you have many thousands of diverse tasks. LoRA shines for narrow behavior shifts on top of a competent base.
You are a concise technical assistant.
A scaling factor applied to the LoRA update: effective scale = alpha / r. Keep alpha/r constant across rank changes (standard: alpha = 2r) so learning rate stays comparable.
You are a concise technical assistant.
How do I serve a LoRA adapter?

Load the base model once and attach the adapter at runtime. vLLM supports --enable-lora with --lora-modules name=path; TGI and SGLang have similar multi-LoRA serving modes. For a single adapter, PeftModel.from_pretrained works.
